subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects parties appealing Department of the Interior decisions, the Interior Board of Land Appeals, and federal courts handling judicial reviews.
dimensions.evidence: A party that files an appeal of a Department of the Interior decision... with the Board of Land Appeals

dimensions.assessment: Imposes strict six-month deadlines on administrative appeals and alters judicial review standards to de novo if deadlines are missed.
dimensions.evidence: judicial review of such decision shall be de novo

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending, revenue, or economic effects.
Modifies agency appeal processes, statutory review timelines, and standards of judicial review for public land and natural resource disputes.
dimensions.evidence: the Board of Land Appeals shall issue a final decision on the appeal by not later than the date that is 6 months

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change applying to pending appeals and all future appeals filed with the board.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall apply to any appeal... pending before the Board... or filed... after the date of enactment

missing_information: Potential administrative cost changes for the Department of the Interior.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes an expedited review timeline and default de novo judicial review procedures for certain Department of the Interior and Board of Land Appeals decisions, directly altering administrative litigation processes for participating parties.
